title: Window
statement: Implement `solve(items, k)`. Return every contiguous window of length `k` as a list of lists. Windows overlap and step by 1. If `k` is less than 1 or greater than the length, return an empty list. Each window is a new list.
hints: The number of windows is len(items) - k + 1 when k is valid.
Reject a non-positive k before you slice.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Overlapping windows are a sliding slice.

editorial: Overlapping windows are a sliding slice. A generator can yield one slice at a time. Copying each slice matters because a later mutation of a shared buffer would corrupt earlier windows. An illegal k yields nothing rather than a partial tail.
